caption:
OpenAI has officially banned accounts associated with Chinese state-linked threat actors Vixen Panda and Keyhole Panda.

Contrary to popular sci-fi tropes, state hackers weren't getting ChatGPT to code self-aware exploits. Instead, they used LLMs as force multipliers for operational efficiency: scripting, language translation, vulnerability research, and technical troubleshooting.

As AI models become essential infrastructure, detecting malicious tradecraft inside model prompts is quickly becoming a critical layer of modern cybersecurity defense.
